sheet_notes.Tileset_4_MV.png: Market/kiosk sheet: tan kiosk & booth fronts (cols 0-5; 4-wide fronts + 2-wide add-on sections), wooden market tables, produce crates, cardboard boxes; right half is European road signs (mostly skipped, avoid).
sheet_notes.Tileset_5_MV.png: Street clutter: red/blue US-style mailboxes, newspaper boxes, porta-potties, construction fence pens, drums, metal trash cans, plaza fountain; graffiti shutters/mats/graffiti tags skipped. Small fountain at 13,0 shares cells with graffiti + trash so it was skipped.
sheet_notes.Tileset_6_MV.png: Construction: red mesh fences, plank hoarding, orange dumpsters, cones, cinder blocks, puddles/dirt; steel scaffolding (cols 8-14) skipped: modules interlock and the lower one is cut at the sheet edge.
sheet_notes.Tileset_7_MV.png: Mostly modern site gear (bulldozers, scissor lifts, light towers, AC units, recycle logos, electric meters) skipped as avoid; kept steel drums and high-voltage signs.
sheet_notes.Tileset_30_MV.png: Best era sheet: wooden utility poles (wires / crossarm / transformer), US green/blue street-name signposts, laundry lines (each 8-wide block splits into a 4-wide clothes line + 4-wide bedsheet line), green garbage cans, wall lamps. Double-globe lamp post at 2,12 skipped: its cells overlap the wall-lamp arms.
sheet_notes.Tileset_57_MV.png: Freight yard: shipping containers (side, door ends), container site office, pipe stack, tires, rope, ladder, scrap. Container roof tops, short 2-wide slices and open-door ends skipped (fragments).
sheet_notes.Tileset_72_MV.png: Garden/florist: flower push carts, wheelbarrows, flower/tool stands, flower buckets, 4 small plank sheds (3x4), ladders; watering cans and hand tools skipped as tiny clutter.
sheet_notes.Tileset_111_MV.png: Entire sheet is European traffic signs on 1x2 posts (triangles, blue discs, yields); only a representative handful cataloged, mostly avoid. No US STOP sign anywhere.
sheet_notes.Tileset_112_MV.png: Bollards, bike rack, ticket machines, crowd-barrier modules, cones, sawhorse barriers, bare signal mast arms plus separate signal heads; mast at 8,0 skipped (pole top cut at sheet edge); pedestrian/lane signal tiles skipped (overlap).
sheet_notes.Tileset_113_MV.png: Complete traffic-signal poles with arms, signal heads and hanging arrow signs (6 variants + 2 hanging-sign poles); bottom row holds cut tops of the next sheet.
sheet_notes.Tileset_Cars_MV.png: Modern compact hatchbacks: 2x4 top views (down/up pairs) and 4x3 side views; teal right-facing side car at 4,1 skipped (red car roof bleeds into its bottom row); pieces at 12,0 and 4,15 are cut at sheet edges.
sheet_notes.Tileset_Cars_2_MV.png: Modern cars: three-box sunroof sedan (ok), fastback, two-tone hatch; 5x3 sides, 3x5/3x4 tops. Row 15, 8,0 and 13,0 are cut at sheet edges.
sheet_notes.Tileset_Cars_3_MV.png: Same layout as Cars_2: lilac/green sunroof sedans (ok), yellow taxi (ok), purple hatch. Edge pieces cut.
sheet_notes.Tileset_Cars_4_MV.png: Modern crossovers/hatches only (avoid) in green/yellow/beige/white; 5x3 sides, 3x4 tops.
sheet_notes.Tileset_Cars_5_MV.png: Beige/white three-box sedans (ok) and cyan/teal sports coupes (avoid). Edge pieces cut.
sheet_notes.Tileset_Cars_6_MV.png: Modern sports coupes only (avoid). Odd orange fragment at 10,12 skipped.
sheet_notes.Tileset_Buses_1_MV.png: Mauve-grey rounded transit bus (4 facings), bus shelters front/side, bus-stop flag signs, painted BUS bay decals.
sheet_notes.Tileset_Buses_2_MV.png: Side views of the same bus in yellow, brown, pink, light blue; each colour faces left (rows 0/8) and right (rows 4/12).
sheet_notes.Tileset_Buses_3_MV.png: Top views of the bus (3x7) facing down/up; blue (row 14+) and pieces at 8,0 / 11,0 / 14,2 / 15,9 are cut at sheet edges.
sheet_notes.Tileset_Fire_Truck_1_MV.png: Fire ladder truck: only the top-down UP-facing view (10,4) is complete; both side views, the down-facing cab (10,0) and the ladder at 2,10 run off the sheet into Tileset_Fire_Truck_2_MV.png (not reviewed).
